notes.rmse_o2_pct: held-out extinction points: predicted vs observed boundary O2 (% points)
notes.coverage90_ext: share of held-out extinction points inside the 90 % predictive interval

summary: Fitted on 71 flame-state points (49 from Burning and Suppression of Solids-II (BASS-II), 22 from BASS-II complementary drop tests (NASA GRC Zero Gravity Research Facility, 5.18 s)). Minimum O2 for burning: 13.6 % (90 % band 13.4-13.9 %) at a = 9.9 1/s; the BASS-II report states ~13.5 % at a = 8-12 1/s. Normal-gravity practice uses 15.4 %.
limitations: Baseline = normal-gravity practice: material burns iff O2 >= 15.4 % (upward limit, BASS-II report p84).
Gravity is a campaign nominal (ISS quasi-steady, <= 2 micro-g, 2001-2002 PIMS data), not measured per test.
Pressure was not reported for the rod tests; the model is only valid at the cabin pressure they ran at.
